items.title: Australia whitewash pushes Bangladesh down to ninth
items.summary: Bangladesh suffered another setback following their eight-wicket defeat to Australia in the third and final WODI in Brisbane on Wednesday, slipping two places to ninth in the latest ICC Women’s ODI rankings.

items.title: Lessons only matter if Bangladesh learn
items.summary: Bangladesh’s historic first-ever tour of Australia ended as expected, with the visitors swept 3-0 in the three-match WODI series following an eight-wicket thrashing in the final game in Brisbane yesterday.

items.title: Afsar Zazai guilty of breaching ICC Code of Conduct against Bangladesh
items.summary: Afghanistan batter Afsar Zazai has been given an official reprimand for breaching level one of the ICC Code of Conduct in the recently concluded one-off Test match against Bangladesh in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: England begin spin preparations for ‘good Test team’ Bangladesh
items.summary: North believes the tour will test England's current team balance, with the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) stepping up its investment in spin bowling as part of a broader effort to strengthen the squad's options.

items.title: Tigresses bow out of Australia tour on a low
items.summary: Bangladesh were bowled out for 172 in 49.5 overs after being asked to bat, with Schutt taking 4-16 from 10 overs, including five maidens. Australia raced to 175 for two in just 22.4 overs, completing the chase with 164 balls to spare and sweeping the series 3-0.

items.title: Swingin' Schutt sets up ODI series sweep for Australia with 4 for 16
items.summary: With Megan Schutt knocking out the top order, Bangladesh were never really in the contest despite half-centuries from Sharmin Akhter and Shorna Akter

items.title: Jack Leach not on England radar for Bangladesh tour

items.title: Alzarri Joseph, Shai Hope to miss WI's two-Test series in Bangladesh

items.summary: White-ball captain Shai Hope has been rested following an extended run across all three formats as West Indies named a 15-member squad for the two-Test series against Bangladesh.
